source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះក្រូចថ្លុងដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ / Climate Resilience Pomelo Growing Technique", Nov 2018, 17pp
text:
The guide recommends drip irrigation (ការគ្រប់គ្រងទឹក) as the preferred watering method for climate-resilient pomelo growing, using the same general system described for orange in this knowledge base: a raised tank or reservoir feeding filtered water through a main line to drip laterals laid along planting rows, with individual drippers at each tree.

Drip irrigation is highlighted specifically for its water-use efficiency compared to flood irrigation, an important advantage as dry-season water availability becomes less reliable, and for reducing the risk of waterlogging around the root zone, which helps protect against Phytophthora and other root diseases favored by wet soil.
